description: fcntl subset (POSIX-gap list, step 1). userspace/ctests/musl_fcntl.c: F_DUPFD is implemented on the Dunit Dup syscall (toolchains/dunit-musl/src/fcntl/fcntl.c) — dup fd 1 to a floor of 10, write through the duplicate (reaches stdout), confirm the floor was honoured. F_GETFL returns a documented ENOSYS (per-fd flag state needs a future Dunit Fcntl syscall), not a fake value. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_fcntl_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: F_DUPFD produced a working duplicate fd (a write through it reached stdout)
the duplicate fd honoured the requested floor (>=10)
an unsupported fcntl command returns a documented ENOSYS, not a fake value

forbidden.why: F_DUPFD did not return a working fd at/above the floor
F_GETFL returned something other than ENOSYS
